dlls.advapi32.dll: Windows security, registry, service-control, and event-log APIs.
dlls.bcrypt.dll: Windows Cryptography API: Next Generation primitives.
dlls.crypt32.dll: Windows certificate and cryptographic message APIs.
dlls.dnsapi.dll: Windows DNS client and resolver APIs.
dlls.iphlpapi.dll: Windows IP configuration and network-adapter APIs.
dlls.kernel32.dll: Core Windows process, thread, memory, file, and synchronization APIs.
dlls.kernelbase.dll: Low-level implementation of many modern Windows base APIs.
dlls.ntdll.dll: Native Windows NT system-call and runtime interface.
dlls.ole32.dll: Windows COM and object activation APIs.
dlls.shell32.dll: Windows Shell operations and integration APIs.
dlls.shlwapi.dll: Windows Shell lightweight path, URL, and registry helpers.
dlls.urlmon.dll: Windows URL moniker and download services.
dlls.user32.dll: Windows user-interface, window, keyboard, and message APIs.
dlls.wininet.dll: Windows Internet client APIs for HTTP and FTP.
dlls.winmm.dll: Windows multimedia and high-resolution timing APIs.
dlls.libc.so: Standard C runtime on Unix-like systems.
dlls.libcurl.so: Client library for URL-based network transfers.
dlls.libsystem.dylib: Core macOS system runtime and POSIX APIs.

apis.AdjustTokenPrivileges: Enables or disables privileges in a Windows access token.
apis.CloseHandle: Closes a Windows kernel object handle.
apis.ConnectNamedPipe: Waits for a client to connect to a Windows named-pipe server.
apis.CreateFile: Creates or opens a Windows file, device, pipe, or other I/O object.
apis.CreateFileMapping: Creates or opens a Windows file-mapping object.
apis.CreateMutex: Creates or opens a named or unnamed Windows mutex.
apis.CreateProcess: Creates a new Windows process and its primary thread.
apis.CreateRemoteThread: Creates a thread in another process; commonly relevant to process injection.
apis.CreateService: Creates a Windows service in the Service Control Manager database.
apis.CryptDecrypt: Decrypts data with the legacy Windows CryptoAPI.
apis.DeviceIoControl: Sends a control code directly to a Windows device driver.
apis.DnsQuery: Queries DNS through the Windows DNS client API.
apis.GetProcAddress: Resolves an exported function address from a loaded module.
apis.IsDebuggerPresent: Reports whether the current process is being debugged.
apis.LoadLibrary: Loads a dynamic-link library into the current Windows process.
apis.NtCreateThreadEx: Creates a native Windows thread, optionally in another process.
apis.NtQueryInformationProcess: Queries native Windows process information, including anti-debug data.
apis.OpenProcess: Opens a handle to a Windows process.
apis.OpenProcessToken: Opens the access token associated with a Windows process.
apis.OpenSCManager: Opens the Windows Service Control Manager database.
apis.RegCreateKeyEx: Creates or opens a Windows Registry key.
apis.RegSetValueEx: Writes data to a Windows Registry value.
apis.SetThreadContext: Changes the processor context of a Windows thread.
apis.ShellExecute: Starts an application or opens a document through the Windows Shell.
apis.Sleep: Suspends execution of the current thread for an interval.
apis.VirtualAlloc: Reserves or commits virtual memory in the current process.
apis.VirtualAllocEx: Allocates virtual memory in another process; relevant to process injection.
apis.VirtualProtect: Changes memory-page protection in the current process.
apis.WinExec: Runs an application using the legacy Windows execution API.
apis.WinHttpOpenRequest: Creates a Windows HTTP request handle.
apis.WriteFile: Writes bytes to a Windows file, device, or pipe handle.
apis.WriteProcessMemory: Writes memory in another process; commonly relevant to process injection.
apis.connect: Connects a socket to a remote network endpoint.
apis.dlopen: Loads a shared object at runtime on a Unix-like system.
apis.execve: Replaces the current Unix process image with another program.
apis.fork: Creates a child process on a Unix-like system.
apis.ptrace: Controls or inspects another Unix process; used by debuggers and anti-debug logic.
apis.system: Passes a command to the host command processor.
